name: aidlc-platform
description: AIDLC Platform — AI-powered Software Development Lifecycle platform on AWS

scripts.deploy-infrastructure: ASSETS_BUCKET=$(bash scripts/package-assets.sh | tail -n 1) && yarn workspace cdk cdk deploy --require-approval never -c assetsBucketName=${ASSETS_BUCKET}
scripts.deploy-infrastructure-no-rollback: ASSETS_BUCKET=$(bash scripts/package-assets.sh | tail -n 1) && yarn workspace cdk cdk deploy --require-approval never -c assetsBucketName=${ASSETS_BUCKET} --no-rollback
